visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of pill/button tabs (Insurance, Membership, Travel, Financial), one selected at a time; the selected tab reveals its panel of content below. Tab buttons wrap on small screens.
contentPattern: Each source row = tab label cell + tab panel content cell. Panels hold the per-category content (action tiles, product cards, promos, FAQs).
usage: Account self-serve hub tab switcher grouping content by product category.
